prior_works.title: STaRK: Benchmarking LLM Retrieval on Textual and Relational Knowledge Bases
prior_works.authors: Shirley Wu, Shiyu Zhao, Michihiro Yasunaga, Kexin Huang, Kaidi Cao, Qian Huang, Vassilis N. Ioannidis, Karthik Subbian, James Zou, Jure Leskovec
prior_works.relationship_sentence: The "STaRK" benchmark defines the heterogeneous, text-rich KG retrieval tasks and datasets and the entity-level evaluation protocol that this paper uses to validate its adaptive breadth-depth retrieval design.

prior_works.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
prior_works.authors: Shunyu Yao, Jeffrey Zhao, Dian Yu, Nan Du, Izhak Shafran, Karthik Narasimhan, Yuan Cao
prior_works.relationship_sentence: The "ReAct" framework introduced the pattern of interleaving LLM reasoning with external tool calls, directly inspiring the paper's prompt-driven two-tool interface that lets a model alternate between global search and neighborhood exploration.

prior_works.relationship_sentence: The "Tree-of-Traversals" traversal-based approach exposes the fragility of seed-dependent multi-hop exploration—an anchoring failure mode that the current work addresses by keeping global search available throughout traversal.

prior_works.title: Think-on-Graph: Prompted Traversal for Knowledge Graph Reasoning
prior_works.authors: Jiashuo Sun, Chengjin Xu, Lumingyuan Tang, Saizhuo Wang, Chen Lin, Yeyun Gong, Lionel M. Ni, Heung-Yeung Shum, Jian Guo
prior_works.relationship_sentence: The "Think-on-Graph" family of methods demonstrates reliance on pre-selected seeds and fixed hop strategies for multi-step graph reasoning, motivating the paper's adaptive, seed-agnostic breadth-depth switching.

prior_works.title: HybGRAG: Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Textual and Relational Knowledge Bases
prior_works.authors: Meng-Chieh Lee, Qi Zhu, Costas Mavromatis, Zhen Han, Soji Adeshina, Vassilis N. Ioannidis, Huzefa Rangwala, Christos Faloutsos
prior_works.relationship_sentence: The "HybGRAG" hybrid retrieval design—mixing global semantic retrieval with local relational signals but operating as a largely static scoring pipeline—serves as a core comparative baseline whose coverage-vs-depth tradeoffs the paper aims to improve.

prior_works.title: Distilling LLM Agent into Small Models with Retrieval and Code Tools
prior_works.authors: Minki Kang, Jongwon Jeong, Seanie Lee, Jaewoong Cho, Sung Ju Hwang
prior_works.relationship_sentence: Kang et al.'s label-free trajectory distillation supplies the practical method for compressing a teacher agent's tool-use trajectories into a compact model—an approach the paper adopts to produce its 8B distilled retriever.

synthesis_narrative: 支撑本工作的文献包含互补的技术脉络。"STaRK"基准确立了具体的问题设定——异构、文本丰富的KG以及实体级Hit@1/MRR评估——这促使方法必须在全局覆盖与多跳关系推理之间取得平衡。在LLM智能体方面，"ReAct"将模型推理与外部工具动作的交错执行形式化，为暴露一个由提示指定的小型工具集以控制检索行为提供了模板。在图遍历方面，"Tree-of-Traversals"和"Think-on-Graph"等方法具体展示了多跳探索策略，但也揭示了关键失效模式：对种子选择的依赖以及固定跳数策略会导致锚定和证据遗漏。与遍历工作互补的是，像"HybGRAG"这样的混合检索器展示了结合语义检索与局部图信号如何提升覆盖，但通常仍是静态评分流水线，无法动态切换搜索模式。最后，来自"Distilling Interactive Policies via Label-free Trajectory Imitation"的实用压缩技术提供了一种可操作方案，用于将昂贵的教师交互转化为紧凑、无标签的学生模型。这些脉络共同揭示了一个明确机会：在可提示的工具接口下，将持续的全局发现与可组合的一跳扩展相结合，然后压缩所得的自适应策略。当前论文自然由此展开：实现一个最小的双工具LLM智能体，使其在无种子依赖的情况下交替进行广度与深度探索，在"STaRK"上评估，并使用无标签轨迹蒸馏产生高效的蒸馏检索器。
